newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London fall, await U.S. economic data.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London fall, await U.S. economic data.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London drifted downwards on Monday in featureless trading as investors looked to U.S. consumer price data due on Tuesday to provide further direction, dealers said.
The Hong Kong London Reference Index eased 33.24 points to close at 14,361.36 after the Hang Seng index finished 282.05 points higher at 14,394.60 in Hong Kong.
"There is no real incentive for people to get involved," said on dealer. "We are waiting for the U.S. CPI data on Tuesday to give us a lead."
HSBC Holdings fell HK$1.00 to HK$230.00 but dealers said it was a creditable performance in the wake of sharp losses suffered by shares in UK banks.
Shares in UK banking stocks tumbled in London, undermined by a profits warning by National Westminster Bank Plc.
